brief:
When France, Britain and other Western powers recognized a Palestinian state last year, entrepreneur Adam Bader felt a sense of hope, Al-Monitor reported. Yet a year later, the symbolic gesture has yielded no tangible advances toward actual Palestinian sovereignty or independence.

The recognition, which came amid international pressure following escalated Israeli-Palestinian tensions, has not translated into meaningful political or diplomatic progress on the ground. Palestinian officials and observers say the gap between symbolic acknowledgment and substantive change remains as wide as ever.

title: Western recognition leaves Palestinian statehood no closer to reality
